# Westfield Prep Center

> Los Angeles fulfillment center and prep center for e-commerce brands shipping 1,000 or more orders per month. Shopify order fulfillment, Amazon FBA prep, TikTok Shop fulfillment, kitting and bundling, storage, and returns processing, with photo proof on every receipt.

## Company facts

- Facility: Los Angeles, California. Service-area business covering all 50 states.
- Legal entity: Sathatham LLC. Westfield Prep Center is a DBA of Sathatham LLC.
- Channels served: Shopify, Amazon FBA, TikTok Shop, and multi-channel e-commerce.
- Typical client: brands shipping 1,000 or more orders per month.
- Volume: 2,000,000+ orders fulfilled, 99.8% accuracy rate, 15+ years in operation, 100+ active brands.
- Phone: 1.818.935.5478
- Email: info@westfieldprepcenter.com
